players.product: PECVD and gas-phase etch systems for DRAM/NAND

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 earnings deck: revenue rose 27.2% quarter on quarter (from KRW 97,243 million in Q1) on memory customers' new-fab and technology-transition investment, operating profit rose 17.2% quarter on quarter with the operating margin at 21%, and net income rose 38.5% quarter on quarter. Outlook and strategy: memory customers' technology transitions and new-fab investment continue through 2026, new-product development and sales growth, and stronger overseas marketing with rising sales to overseas customers
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 revenue +27.2% QoQ (Q1 2026: KRW 97,243 million); operating margin 21%

quarterly_data.signal: Sales by application: in H1 2026 DRAM was 60% and NAND 40% of revenue (FY2025: 60% / 40%; FY2024: 77% / 23%). The company estimates it holds a 30%+ global share of combined DRAM and NAND ACL (amorphous carbon layer) deposition equipment, an oligopoly position it expects to widen toward 35% by 2027 on advanced-node transitions and overseas marketing (company estimate using TrendForce market weights). Named main customers are Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix in memory and Samsung Electronics in logic, with Applied Materials, Lam Research and TEL as competitors; its product line covers advanced ACL, ARC, gap-fill and low-k PECVD, backside deposition, EUV layer, quad-chamber SiCN/SiN systems and GPE/RPE dry cleaning
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 DRAM 60%, NAND 40%; memory ACL equipment share 30%+ (company estimate), 35% targeted for 2027

quarterly_data.signal: Plant capacity: the Yongin head office (semiconductor CVD and dry-cleaning equipment) can build 168 units a year, the Wonsam plant (deep-UV and SiC MOCVD for compound semiconductors) 25 units a year and the Hwaseong plant (PECVD and ALD for OLEDoS thin-film encapsulation) 24 units a year; a new R&D centre of 20,304 m2 on six floors was built in 2025, and R&D spending runs above 10% of revenue

Diversification: TES is developing SiC and GaN epitaxial growth (MOCVD) equipment for power semiconductors used in EVs, power supplies, RF and data centres, positioning for a shift in GaN epi structures from Fe/C-doped GaN buffers to thick AlN buffers that it sees as a new business opportunity for AlN thin-film tools; its OED division also sells deep-UV LED MOCVD and OLEDoS PECVD for XR micro displays
